summary.what_it_does: The page describes Bespoke Sound as a studio of DJs, musicians, and audiophiles that designs custom soundtracks for hospitality experiences run by lifestyle, luxury, and boutique brands. The site's navigation lists sections for work, services, about, blog, and contact, plus pages titled "Our greatest hits", "Your brand in surround sound", "The signal in the noise", and "Our liner notes". The page text does not describe specific services, pricing, or how the music is produced. A directory listing describes it as custom AI music solutions, but the page itself does not mention AI.
notable: Studio of DJs, musicians, and audiophiles focused on brand audio
Targets lifestyle, luxury, and boutique hospitality brands
caveats: Page does not state pricing or service terms
Page text does not mention AI; the AI label comes only from the external listing
